cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The 'message' string from the JsonObject is directly assigned to the 'title' field without any sanitization or encoding, which could allow injection of malicious scripts if this value is later output in a web page, leading to Cross-site Scripting (XSS).
